input: Teamwork is useful because people have different skills.
question: Why is teamwork useful?

key_issues.message: 回答过于简短，缺乏具体例子和深入解释
只有一个观点，没有展开或逻辑连接
原句语法正确但过于简单，缺少复杂句式

feedback.optimization_summary: 扩展了原句，增加了具体例子（学校项目中的分工）和额外理由（互相学习、提升沟通能力），并添加了总结句。保持了原意，但使回答更充实、更有逻辑。
feedback.final_upgraded_answer: Teamwork is useful because it brings together people with different skills, which allows us to solve problems more creatively and efficiently. For example, in a school project, one person might be good at designing, another at writing, and another at presenting. By working together, we can combine these strengths and produce a better result than any one person could alone. Also, teamwork helps us learn from each other and build communication skills, which are valuable in both study and future work. So, overall, teamwork not only improves the quality of the outcome but also makes the process more enjoyable and educational.
feedback.reference_answer: Teamwork is useful because it encourages shared responsibility and reduces individual pressure. When people work as a team, tasks can be divided according to each person's strengths, which makes the work more efficient. Moreover, team members can support each other when facing challenges, which builds confidence and resilience. In my opinion, teamwork also fosters a sense of belonging, as everyone feels their contribution matters. This not only leads to better outcomes but also helps develop important social skills that are essential in any career.
